										<div      class="vc_row wpb_row section vc_row-fluid  grid_section" style=' padding-top:82px; padding-bottom:45px; text-align:left;'><div class=" section_inner clearfix"><div class='section_inner_margin clearfix'><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h2 style="text-align: center;">Kite or dive trip</h2>
		</div> 
	</div> <div class="separator  small center  " style="margin-top: 17px;margin-bottom: 60px;"></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">Join us on Bonaire for an amazing kite or dive trip!</p>
		</div> 
	</div> </div></div></div></div></div></div><div      class="vc_row wpb_row section vc_row-fluid  grid_section" style='background-color:#f8f8f8; padding-top:75px; padding-bottom:42px; text-align:left;'><div class=" section_inner clearfix"><div class='section_inner_margin clearfix'><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-12"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div      class="vc_row wpb_row section vc_row-fluid vc_inner " style=' text-align:left;'><div class=" full_section_inner clearfix"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_left  element_from_left"><div style="-webkit-animation-delay:0.2s; animation-delay:0.2s; -webkit-transition-delay:0.2s; transition-delay:0.2s">
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper   vc_box_border_grey"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1024" height="576"   alt="Kiting in paradise" data-srcset="https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-1024x576.jpg 1024w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-300x169.jpg 300w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-768x432.jpg 768w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-700x394.jpg 700w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-539x303.jpg 539w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2.jpg 2048w"  data-src="https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-1024x576.jpg" data-sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" class="vc_single_image-img attachment-large lazyload" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" /><noscript><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1024" height="576" src="https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-1024x576.jpg" class="vc_single_image-img attachment-large" alt="Kiting in paradise" srcset="https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-1024x576.jpg 1024w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-300x169.jpg 300w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-768x432.jpg 768w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-700x394.jpg 700w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2-539x303.jpg 539w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-2.jpg 2048w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></noscript></div>
		</div></div>
	</div>
<div class="separator  transparent   " style="margin-top: 22px;margin-bottom: 0px;"></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h5>Kite trip</h5>
<p>Kite spot Atlantis/Kite Beach is located at the same road as BEACHES, further south. It is a perfect kite spot, with its warm and flat waters and steady winds! Join the relaxed kite community, meet new people and kite with turtles and (if you are lucky) dolphins.</p>
		</div> 
	</div> <div class="separator  transparent   " style="margin-top: 13px;margin-bottom: 25px;"></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>$525 per person (based on 4 persons)</h3>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Including:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>7 nights stay in 2 p. design studio apartment at BEACHES ocean view apartments</li>
<li>breakfast at seafront location</li>
<li>pick-up truck</li>
<li>airport transfers</li>
<li>10% discount on kite and dive courses</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Excluding:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>flights</li>
<li>tourist tax of $5.45 per person per night</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Kite trip: April – August, mid November &#8211; mid December (exceptions of the kite school apply)</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Choose your own starting date (last-minutes even cheaper!), inquire today: <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#91f8fff7fed1f3f4f0f2f9f4e2bcf3fefff0f8e3f4bff2fefc"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="167f78707956747377757e73653b747978777f64733875797b">[email&#160;protected]</span></a></p>
		</div> 
	</div> <div class="separator  transparent   " style="margin-top: 13px;margin-bottom: 0px;"></div>
</div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper">
	<div class="wpb_single_image wpb_content_element vc_align_left  element_from_right"><div style="-webkit-animation-delay:0.2s; animation-delay:0.2s; -webkit-transition-delay:0.2s; transition-delay:0.2s">
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<div class="vc_single_image-wrapper   vc_box_border_grey"><img decoding="async" width="1024" height="576"   alt="Diving in paradise" data-srcset="https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-1024x576.jpg 1024w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-300x169.jpg 300w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-768x432.jpg 768w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-700x394.jpg 700w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-539x303.jpg 539w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3.jpg 2048w"  data-src="https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-1024x576.jpg" data-sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" class="vc_single_image-img attachment-large lazyload" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" /><noscript><img decoding="async" width="1024" height="576" src="https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-1024x576.jpg" class="vc_single_image-img attachment-large" alt="Diving in paradise" srcset="https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-1024x576.jpg 1024w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-300x169.jpg 300w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-768x432.jpg 768w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-700x394.jpg 700w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3-539x303.jpg 539w, https://www.beaches-bonaire.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/FB-3.jpg 2048w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></noscript></div>
		</div></div>
	</div>
<div class="separator  transparent   " style="margin-top: 22px;margin-bottom: 0px;"></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h5>Dive trip</h5>
<div id=":4s" class="a3s aXjCH ">
<div dir="ltr">
<div class="gmail_default">Bonaire is truly a diver’s paradise. There are numerous dive sites which are easily accessible and which you can dive independently. You can start your diving adventure next door with dive operator Wannadive Bonaire. All southern dive sites are within close reach and perfect for shore diving.</div>
</div>
</div>
		</div> 
	</div> <div class="separator  transparent   " style="margin-top: 13px;margin-bottom: 25px;"></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element ">
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<h3>$525 per person (based on 4 persons)</h3>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Including:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>7 nights stay in 2 p. design studio apartment at BEACHES ocean view apartments</li>
<li>breakfast at seafront location</li>
<li>pick-up truck</li>
<li>airport transfers</li>
<li>10% discount on kite and dive courses</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Excluding:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>flights</li>
<li>tourist tax of $5.45 per person per night</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Dive trip: April – mid December</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
